summary: Magic Empire Global Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement for a private placement. The company sold 40,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.168 per share, raising $6,720,000, which is 15% of the prior day's closing price. The offering relied on Regulation S for non-U.S. purchasers. Closing occurred on August 25, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not an activist, strategic, or restructuring event. No special-situation characteristics are present; the filing is a standard private placement disclosure.
